name: row
title: Selectable row
summary: A row people pick in a sidebar or browser: the surface under the pointer and the selection.
use: For lists of items people select and act on: media, files, sessions.
anatomy: Surface behind the hovered or selected row

options.name: selected
options.description: Whether the row is the selection.

rules: Selection is surface, never ink or the accent.
Rows keep their words in ink.
accessibility: A selected row has the selected trait.
